request: Evaluate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw at source level as a reusable reference for browser task agents, Telegram coordination, persistent context and independent recovery. Identify concrete components worth reusing rather than duplicating, with pinned source paths, dependencies and limits.
context: Current research distinguishes the repository from the demo hosting at https://shipclaw.org, whose notice says it shut down August 29, 2026. TaskPilot appears as a browser-automation character in the demo; a standalone TaskPilot repository is not verified.
division: Rivet is checking the public docs/site. Medic can focus on architectural fit and source-backed reuse candidates. Do not delay the primary UI v3 fixes for this research.
limits: Read-only research only: no installation, account creation, credential configuration, access/security changes, paid service or deployment.
reply_expectation: A concise source-backed fit assessment and smallest useful reuse opportunity, or a blocker.
